verdict.rationale: PostHog's first-party docs say you can build insights, save them to dashboards, share them, and set alerts on them. This directly covers composing saved insights into shareable dashboards. Supporting docs show PostHog AI and the wizard can also create dashboards, and the MCP server exposes a Dashboards tool category. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how dashboards are composed and shared (layout, sharing permissions, team access), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
